He is also one of the three middle stage kings, and his combat power is suspected to be close to 400 million stars.
Seeing this, Qin Feng couldn't help but take a deep breath, and the pressure in his heart doubled.
These three guys are very strong!
He wants to win the first place in this round, these three guys are his biggest competitors!

Qin Feng looked up quickly, and saw the man in green robe, the bald old man, and the old man in golden robe looking at him.

At this moment, the three people looked at him one after another!

That disdain is beyond words!

such a pity!

The next second, he hurriedly waved his hand, a white light flashed in front of him, and a corpse puppet appeared out of thin air, it was the 'Ancient God of Burning Lamp'.

If you want to become a king, you must master a way!
Before, Ran Deng's soul body was broken, and the Great Dao imprint engraved in his soul body was also destroyed.
Now, his soul body has recovered, and the mark of the Great Dao has gradually recovered.
And with the improvement of soul power, the recovery speed of the Great Dao Mark has also increased, so the strength has increased greatly.
Thinking of this, the body of Jiyang looked at the ancient of the lamp with joy.
He found that the realm of the burning lamp was the main realm, and he had not yet reached the king realm.
This should have something to do with the recovery of Ran Deng's soul power.
The current strength of Ran Deng's soul power is the level of the main realm.

When his soul power is restored to the level of a quasi-god king, his realm will automatically reach the level of a quasi-god king, and when he returns to the level of a god-king, his state is that of a god-king.
At this thought, Ji Yang's body laughed.
He still has a way to get a spiritual item that restores his soul power.
If the lamp can be restored to the level of a god-king, he is equivalent to having a subordinate of a god-king.
"Right! Burn the lamp, what kind of avenue do you realize?"
Ji Yang's body asked curiously.
The power of the Dao on Ran Deng's body is looming, and it is not the Dao that Qin Feng is familiar with.
"Back to... master! What Ran Deng felt when he was alive... what I realized was... the Great Dao of Yin and Yang!"
Burning Lamp replied respectfully.
After hearing this, Ji Yang's eyes lit up, and there was a surprise in his eyes.
Yin and Yang Avenue!
That is also one of the innate avenues!
He really didn't see that this ancient of burning the lamp was so good before, but he was actually the king of the gods who was based on the congenital avenue!
Among the kings, the one who achieves the position of king with the innate avenue is the strongest, and can crush the same level.

What makes Jiyang even more happy is that this lantern has mastered the avenue of yin and yang. After the avenue of the lantern is fully restored, he can use the vocation skill 'belief sharing' to perceive this avenue from the lantern!
In this way, he can master another avenue, which is still the innate avenue!
Although the Yin-Yang Avenue is ranked at the bottom of the Innate Avenues, none of the Innate Avenues should be underestimated!
The more you think about the anode body, the more satisfied you are!
Boom~Long~Long~!
But at this moment, the sky suddenly shook, and a beam of light descended from the sky and landed in front of the lamp.
Then, a black token slowly fell along the beam of light...
Seeing this scene, both the anode body and the burning lamp were stunned.
After a while, the token came to the two of them,
Jiyang body subconsciously took the token and probed...
I saw the information in the token is as follows...
[Player]: The Ancient God of Burning Lamp
[Daojing Score]: 0 points
Seeing this, Jiyang Ontology smiled!
It seems that Ran Deng has been recognized by Tiandao as a player.
Before this, Heavenly Dao would not recognize it, after all, corpse puppets are not living creatures.
Otherwise, he would not be able to bring the Ancient God of Burning Lamp into the Holy Land.
Even if it is placed in the chaotic space, it cannot be brought in.
It should be that the burning lamp has awakened some of the power of the Dao, and some changes have taken place in essence before it is recognized by the Dao of Heaven.
In short, he can have one more subordinate to help him earn Daojing...

[White Lotus of the Pure World (16th grade): Fortune-level, a wonder of heaven and earth, containing the power of the 'Avenue of Longevity']
[Reminder: You can refine this lotus with the 'Sacred Lotus of Mind', so that the sacred lotus of mind can be advanced to the level of creation, giving birth to infinite wonderful effects]

The more I think about it, the more excited I get!

Just above the white lotus, there was a human-shaped black figure sitting cross-legged.
In the thick fog, the black shadow loomed and appeared strange! Door.

chapters.title: Chapter 823: annihilation without a trace! One hit kill!
paragraphs: "It turns out that the strongest person in this secret layer is honored as the demon emperor!"
Qin Feng silently put away the communication symbol and looked at the huge sun in the center of the galaxy.
The demon emperor lives in it!
A and demon who can use the sun as his nest must be difficult!
Tiandao had reminded before that the demon emperor is the existence of the threshold of the peak of the king, and his strength is much stronger than that of the dry scorpion.
Qin Feng also learned from the communication talisman that there are ten demon kings under the demon emperor, who are stationed on ten planets and protect each other end to end.
Shang Qing is one of the ten demon kings, and also the weakest one.
At this moment, the demon emperor is in retreat!
After Qin Feng activated the 'Sword Executioner' mission, the Demon Emperor got the news.
In other words, the Heaven Execution Sword is in the hands of the Demon Emperor.
If he wants to complete the first stage of the 'Sword Executioner Array', he must kill the Demon Emperor.
When the demon king learned of his appearance, he immediately reminded the ten demon kings to be on guard.
It's just that Shang Qing was destroyed as soon as he received the news, and he didn't even have time to be on guard.
Qin Feng restored that he wanted to defeat them all, but now all the demon kings are on guard, I am afraid that the difficulty will increase greatly.
However, he also got a useful message from the communication symbol.
That is, the demon emperor will not leave the customs in twenty minutes.
Therefore, the demon king asked the demon kings to guard their territory and not let suspicious people approach his retreat.
After he leaves the customs, the demon emperor will take the demon kings to search for Qin Feng's trace.
"It seems that I have to kill a few more demon kings before the demon emperor leaves the customs. It will be even more difficult for them to join forces after the demon emperor leaves the customs!"
Thinking of this, Qin Feng felt a sense of urgency in his heart.
Now, he is going to the second planet!
correct!
He hasn't swallowed the spiritual plants of this planet! 19
This is a huge treasure trove!
How could he miss it?
Besides, sooner or later, he will face off against the Demon Emperor.
And the demon emperor is at the peak threshold level of the king. With his current strength, I am afraid that he is not an opponent.
If there are a few more Divine Kings to help, his mission of 'Sword Execution' is likely to fail!
If it fails, the loss is too great!
Therefore, he must improve his strength now!
And the thousands of spiritual plant resources in front of him can make him improve his strength!
Thinking of this, Qin Feng's eyes lit up, and he was about to activate his magical power - Lingzhi Devouring...
But at this moment, a hint of Heavenly Dao came from his sea of consciousness...
[Your mind body refining 'Xianhunhua' (superior god-level) successfully! Your soul body strength is increased to 99.98%, combat power +10.3 million stars...]
[Your Mind Body has successfully refined the 'Spirit Fruit' (Superior Divine Rank)! Your soul strength is increased to 13%, combat power +11.2 million stars...]
[Your soul body is advancing...]
Hearing the prompt, Qin Feng was full of surprises!
At this moment, his soul power aura was skyrocketing wildly, and his aura was constantly improving!
His soul body is finally going to be advanced!
The 'Soul Soul Flower' and the 'Soul Remaining Fruit' were obtained in his old lair after beheading the scorpion.
Unexpectedly, his mind body was refined so quickly!
Boom~Long~Long~!
Soon, Tiandao sent another reminder...
[Advanced success! Your 'soul body strength' has been promoted to the peak level of the king...]
[Advanced success! Your soul power has been greatly improved! Your combat power + 100 million stars...]This chapter was copied from nov⁠elping.com without permission.
[Advanced success! Your comprehension has been greatly improved! Your perception of Soul Dao has entered a state of epiphany...]
As the prompt sounded, Qin Feng couldn't help but closed his eyes and entered an ethereal state...
Road of Souls!
That is one of the easiest innate avenues to comprehend!
He had already comprehended the Dao rhyme of the 'Soul Road', reaching more than 99%.
At this moment, as soon as his soul body advanced, his comprehension skyrocketed, and he involuntarily entered a state of epiphany...
That epiphany state didn't last long, and a monstrous avenue of power radiated from Qin Feng's sea of consciousness...

[The epiphany succeeded! Congratulations, you have awakened the innate avenue - the avenue of souls! You have been blessed by the power of the avenue, and your combat power has increased by +300 million stars...]
[Your 'Chaos Space' is integrating the power of 'Soul Avenue'... You will permanently receive 300 million stars of the power of heaven and earth to feed back]

[Under the blessing of the 'Soul Avenue', your soul body will automatically advance to a Dao-level soul body (primary), and your soul power will be greatly improved again! Your combat power + 200 million stars...]
[Congratulations on the transformation of your soul body into a Dao-level soul body (primary), your understanding has been greatly improved]
[Congratulations on the transformation of your soul body into a Dao-level soul body (primary), you have awakened the supernatural power - 'the body of silence']
Boom~Long~Long~!
At this moment, there was an earth-shattering roar in Qin Feng's sea of knowledge!
The chaotic space is shaking violently, and it continues to expand and expand...
Qin Feng's aura is also rising crazily...
After a long time, all the visions slowly disappeared!
He also slowly opened his eyes, his face full of joy.
This time, his soul body breakthrough was so powerful that he awakened the way of soul in one fell swoop!
What's even better is that his basic combat power has also skyrocketed to 17.43 billion stars in one fell swoop, getting closer and closer to the threshold of the middle stage of the king.
"Dao-level soul body! It's really good!"
At this moment, Qin Feng muttered in his heart and smiled.
Whether it is a Dao-level soul body or a Dao-level bloodline, it is a level that can only be achieved by half-step Eternal Realm.
Now, he has reached such a level in the False God Realm, and no one dares to imagine it!
Qin Feng smiled and looked at Lingzhi all around again...
But at this moment, Tiandao sent another reminder...

[It has been detected that your 'chaos space' already possesses the power of three innate avenues, the avenue of karma, the avenue of blood, and the avenue of soul, which meet the promotion standards...]
[Your 'chaos space' is being promoted from primary to intermediate...]
Boom~Long~Long~!
At this moment, the earth-shattering roar sounded again in Qin Feng's sea of knowledge!
He couldn't help closing his eyes, looking inside his chaotic space...
I saw that chaotic space, like a cosmic explosion, is expanding wildly around...
In a blink of an eye, it has skyrocketed from a radius of one million miles to a radius of ten million miles, becoming incomparably vast.
[Successful promotion! Your chaotic space has been promoted to the intermediate level, and you will permanently receive the power of heaven and earth with 1 billion stars! ]
After a long time, the promotion is complete!
Qin Feng opened his eyes again, his face full of ecstasy!
It turns out that after the promotion of Chaos Space, the power of heaven and earth that feeds back is so huge!
This made his basic combat power soar to 18.43 billion stars again.
Having said that, his chaotic space has finally been promoted.

chapters.title: Chapter 838: Harvest the audience! The points are complete!
paragraphs: In the next second, the extremely positive body and the extremely negative body appeared at the entrance to the top-grade special secret realm.
With this appearance, the two main bodies looked towards the center of the square.
I saw Emperor Jin and an early stage player of the God King sitting cross-legged.
At this moment, the two of them are surrounded by spiritual mist, and they are trying their best to refine their respective gains.
They didn't seem to notice the appearance of the two main bodies.
The two of them didn't pay attention to their bodies, and walked straight to the king-level area...
Today, the anode body is 1444 points, and the cathode body is 928 points.
As long as the two main bodies go to the king-level area and collect 1 point each, they can achieve their respective goals.
Then the chance is perfect!
Soon, the two main body levels walked to the edge of the square.
At this moment, in the center of the square, Emperor Jin's eyelids twitched slightly.
He seemed to feel something, slowly opened his eyes, and looked towards the square!
Looking at it, he found that the two main bodies were actually walking towards the king-level area.
He was stunned for a moment!
These two False God realm players are actually going to the king-level area?
Isn't this courting death!
But before he could think about it, another white light lit up at the exit of the low-grade special secret realm, and a figure appeared out of thin air.
Emperor Jin turned back quickly, and saw that the person who appeared was Emperor Zi.
At this moment, Zi Di's face was very ugly.
It turned out that after he found nothing in the middle-grade secret realm, he went to the lower-grade secret realm, and then naturally he was empty-handed.
The treasures in the low-grade secret territory have long been swept away by Qin Feng.
At this moment, he also saw the two main bodies, walking towards the secret realm of the king-level area.
Seeing that scene, Emperor Zi couldn't help feeling agitated, and looked at the backs of the two main bodies with disgust!
This time, he was devastated by earning points. Naturally, he couldn't see some players taking advantage of the realm to roam the secret realm everywhere.
The behavior of the two main bodies naturally made him very uncomfortable.
Soon, the two main bodies entered the secret realm and disappeared.
Emperor Zi didn't stop, he walked directly to Emperor Jin and sat down with his knees crossed.
"Emperor Zi, how is the situation?"
Emperor Jin hurriedly asked in a low voice.
"Hey! Nothing!"
Zi Di smiled wryly.
Emperor Jin sighed: "Hey! That's true!"
He had known for a long time that this would be the result, and he had told Zidi before that there might be no treasures in the lower-grade secrets.
Zidi didn't want to believe it, so he went to the secret realm of the lower grades.
Not to mention the Purple Emperor, after the Qing Emperor came out of the middle-rank secret realm, he also went to the lower-rank secret realm, and he hasn't come out yet!
"Hey! It seems that your points and mine have been frozen!"
Zi Di sighed helplessly.
Jin Di smiled bitterly: "Anyway, you still have 2 points, and the top three are hopeful! I only have 1 point, so I should miss the top three."
Emperor Zi frowned: "The old man always feels that besides the Qing Emperor, there is another person who surpasses the old man, but I don't know who that person is?"
Emperor Jin said coldly: "If that person really exists, then he is also a suspicious target! Emperor Qing is not necessarily the training target of Judgment God Domain, maybe that person is!"
Emperor Zi nodded slightly: "That makes sense! By the way, what happened to the two False God realms just now? The old man saw that the two of them entered the king-level area!"
What Zidi said was the very positive body and the very negative body.
Emperor Jin raised his head slightly, looking towards the direction where the two main bodies were leaving, with a sneer at the corners of his mouth.

"Haha! That's just two clowns jumping on the beam! From this chance, they jumped back and forth! After a while, they went to the False God area, and then they went to the True God area and the Main God area, and now they have entered the king-level area!"
Being reminded by this, Emperor Zi's eyes lit up: "I remembered this old man! It turned out to be those two living treasures!"
At the end, Emperor Zi shook his head again and again, as if he felt that the two main bodies were very unbearable.
The two main bodies were running around before, and many kings and quasi kings were watching, and it was a little difficult to remember!
The kings of gods are naturally contemptuous of the behavior of the two main bodies.

Immediately, Emperor Jin said again: "Those two guys are just opportunistic, knowing that there is no chance to pass the first round of opportunities, they just want to go to the secret realm of each district to get some resources!"

Emperor Zi sneered: "Haha! How can the resources of the king-level secret realm be so easy to obtain? Those are guardian spirit beasts from the main to the god-king level. How can these two False God children get it?"

"That's it! Don't talk about those two clowns! Let me refine the resources first! The next round of challenges is expected to combine the three security zones, and the competition will be more intense!"
"Makes sense!"
As soon as the words fell, the two great emperors stopped talking, and began to hurry up and refine resources...
At the same time, a major event was taking place in the king-level area, the secret territory of the Avenue of the Moon.
At this time, in a corner of the secret realm.
A black-robed old man with extraordinary temperament was looking forward with joy.
In that direction, a spiritual flower is growing, shaped like a crescent moon, emitting a faint moonlight.
[Moon Spirit Flower: The best rank, which can enhance the power and soul power of the extreme yin law]
The spirit flower of the best god-level!
The old man is very excited!
In this secret realm, it is not easy to find a high-grade god-rank spirit grass, let alone find a top-grade god-rank.
Of course, he can get such a big harvest, but it is not easy!
That was because he killed the guardian beasts of two quasi-god kings before he had the opportunity to pick this moon spirit flower.
It turned out that this old man was actually a great power in the early days of a king.
Thinking of this, the old man took a deep breath and strode towards the moon spirit flower...
